entities.name: PDU session status
entities.description: Information element that indicates the PDU sessions that are associated with the access type that the message is sent over that are active within the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the PDU session status IE when it needs to indicate active PDU sessions.

entities.name: Access type
entities.description: The type of access over which the message containing the PDU session status IE is sent.

entities.name: Active PDU sessions
entities.description: PDU sessions that are currently active within the network for the specific access type.

relations.description: Network includes the PDU session status IE in messages when it needs to indicate active PDU sessions.
The PDU session status IE is associated with the access type over which the message is sent.
The PDU session status IE indicates which PDU sessions are active within the network for the given access type.
